issuer: the Wyoming Department of Transportation, Driver Services
note: The Wyoming Statutes, Title 31, on wyoleg.gov (read 2026-10-30): W.S. 31-7-113 charges $40 for a driver's licence plus, in subsection (g), a $5 transportation information system fee on each, $45 in all (the sum is held; $30 to renew); W.S. 31-7-119 has a licence expire on the birthday in the fifth year after issue; W.S. 31-7-108 issues no licence to anyone under 17 but for a 16-year-old after six months on an intermediate permit, so a licence is kept from 17. WYDOT's ID card page (read 2026-10-30) gives the card at $10 with an expiration of eight years, issued to residents of any age (so the card has no age).

sources.title: Wyoming Statutes, Title 31 (Motor Vehicles)
sources.said: (i) Driver's license $40.00 ... an additional transportation information system fee of five dollars ($5.00) shall be imposed ... (a) Every driver's license shall expire on the licensee's birthday in the fifth year following the issuance of the license. ... No driver's license shall be issued to any person who is under the age of seventeen (17) years

sources.title: WYDOT, ID Cards
sources.said: Identification cards may be issued to Wyoming residents of any age. ... The cost of an identification card is $10. ... Identification cards are issued with an expiration date of eight years.
